      tags:
        - hour-registrations
      summary: Register worked hours against a project phase

          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/hourRegistration'
        required: true

    hourRegistration:
      required:
        - projectId
        - projectPhaseId
        - numberOfHours
        - employeeId
        - itemType
        - itemTypeCode
        - dateTime
      type: object
      properties:
        externalDescription:
          type: string
          description: External description.
          example: description
        internalDescription:
          type: string
          description: Internal description.
          example: description
        projectId:
          type: string
          description: Project ID to book hours on.
          example: '123456'
        projectPhaseId:
          type: string
          description: Project phase ID to book hours on.
          example: '123456'
        projectPhaseDescription:
          type: string
          description: Description of the project phase. Used when creating a new phase.
          example: My project phase
        projectPhaseStartDateTime:
          type: string
          description: Date and time of the start of the project phase.
          format: date-time
          example: '2023-01-01T14:00:00.0000000+00:00'
        numberOfHours:
          type: number
          description: Number of hours worked.
          format: double
          example: 1.25
        employeeId:
          type: string
          description: Employee identifier.
          example: '123456'
        description:
          type: string
          description: Description of the activity.
          example: My work on ticket A
        startTime:
          pattern: '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
          type: string
          description: Start time of the activity in HH:mm:ss.
          example: '14:00:00'
        endTime:
          pattern: '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
          type: string
          description: End time of the activity in HH:mm:ss.
          example: '14:01:00'
        markAsApproved:
          type: boolean
          description: Mark item as approved.
          example: false
        markAsCompleted:
          type: boolean
          description: Mark item as completed.
          example: false
        hourType:
          type: string
          description: Hour type.
          example: '1'
        itemType:
          type: string
          description: Item type.
          example: '1'
        itemTypeCode:
          type: string
          description: Item type code.
          example: '01'
        dateTime:
          type: string
          description: Date and time of execution.
          format: date-time
          example: '2023-01-01T14:00:00.0000000+00:00'
      additionalProperties: false
    hourRegistrationResponse:
      required:
        - id
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Calculation rule identifier.
          example: '123'
    error:
      required:
        - error
      type: object
      properties:
        error:
          required:
            - status
            - errors
          type: object
          properties:
            status:
              type: integer
              description: HTTP status code of the response.
              format: int32

            correlationId:
              type: string
              description: Correlation identifier for tracing this request across logs.

            errors:
              minItems: 1
              type: array
              items:
                required:
                  - message
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: string
                    description: Machine readable error code.
                    example: VALIDATION_ERROR
                  field:
                    type: string
                    description: 'Name of the field the error relates to, when applicable.'
                    example: projectId
                  message:
                    type: string
                    description: Human readable description of the error.
                    example: projectId is required.
              description: One or more individual errors.
  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: Bad Request
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/error'
    Unauthorized:
      description: Unauthorized
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/error'
    InternalServerError:
      description: Internal Server Error
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/error'
  securitySchemes:

      type: apiKey
      name: X-ApiKey
      in: header
